Sentinel nonce markers and kernel main output were not visible in the bounded serial windows.

BCM54213PE register values, Ethernet readiness, link readiness, GPIO32/PHY reset ownership, BMCR writes, Broadcom shadow/MMD/aux access, interrupt ownership, broad PHY/MAC configuration, packet I/O, networking, SSH, Phase 12.2, and phase transition remain rejected.

Candidate/control sentinel archives sharing tree and byte size is acceptable for this discriminator because retained nonces and report payload evidence define the two scenarios.
